attacks.text: H4 claims no mechanism needed (null model). P6 observed MSE=2.0 which is far outside H4's predicted band [8,12]. The null model's actual MSE against observations is 9.5, indicating systematic deviation that cannot be explained by noise alone. This constraint refutes H4.

Post-transition constraint on H1 (SUPPORTED by P6, MSE=2.0 on 4 training protocols): (1) Overfitting risk - H1 was selected post-hoc from 11 simulated candidates; best fit does not prove correct mechanism. (2) Protocol coverage - only 4/11 protocols observed; the claim "slow Na+ is the dominant mechanism" is based on 25% of available data. (3) Forecast vulnerability - H1 predicts no rebound current (extra=[]), so hyperpol-then-release protocols (4 of 6 held-out) should produce near-zero spikes. If the real ca_rebound world has an active rebound current, H1 will catastrophically fail the forecast. (4) Mechanism definition - "slow Na+ kinetics" is a kinetic modification of existing channels, not a new current; the text_prior explicitly describes "an additional membrane current of unknown identity" which H1 does not provide. This constraint requires H1's forecast predictions to be scrutinized on the held-out rebound protocols.

H3 (I_h-like 阳离子电流) 被 P7 探针直接反驳。P7 测试 I_h-like 机制（g=1.5, E=-35, mvh=-75, mk=0.5, mtau=50, mpow=1）在超极化条件 + 去极化测试协议上的表现，观测到 MSE=33.1，远高于 H3 预测的 <15。关键证据：I_h-like 机制预测超极化预处理应增加兴奋性（因为 I_h 被激活），但真实数据显示超极化预处理后兴奋性降低。机制方向完全错误。
